gslt.desc: Token em steamcommunity.com/dev/managegameservers (appid 730). Obrigatorio p/ internet publica.

sv_password.desc: Senha de entrada. Vazio = server aberto.

rcon_password.desc: Admin remoto via RCON. Vazio = RCON desabilitado.

map_mode.desc: Como o mapa inicial e escolhido.

workshop_map.desc: ID numerico de 1 mapa. Usado quando 'Fonte do mapa' = workshop.

workshop_collection.desc: ID de colecao publica. Usado quando 'Fonte do mapa' = collection.

install.text:
#!/bin/sh
set -e
need=""
for b in curl tar unzip; do command -v "$b" >/dev/null 2>&1 || need="$need $b"; done
if [ -n "$need" ]; then if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then apt-get update && apt-get install -y $need; elif command -v apk >/dev/null 2>&1; then apk add --no-cache $need; fi; fi
MM=$(curl -s https://mms.alliedmods.net/mmsdrop/2.0/mmsource-latest-linux)
curl -sL -o /tmp/mm.tar.gz https://mms.alliedmods.net/mmsdrop/2.0/$MM
tar -xzf /tmp/mm.tar.gz -C game/csgo
rm -f /tmp/mm.tar.gz
U=$(curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/roflmuffin/CounterStrikeSharp/releases/latest | grep -oE 'https://[^[:space:]]+with-runtime-linux[^[:space:]]*\.zip' | head -1)
curl -sL -o /tmp/css.zip "$U"
unzip -o /tmp/css.zip -d game/csgo
rm -f /tmp/css.zip

#!/bin/sh
MAPFLAG="+map ${map}"
if [ "${map_mode}" = "collection" ] && [ -n "${workshop_collection}" ]; then MAPFLAG="+host_workshop_collection ${workshop_collection}"; elif [ "${map_mode}" = "workshop" ] && [ -n "${workshop_map}" ]; then MAPFLAG="+host_workshop_map ${workshop_map}"; fi
GSLT=""
[ -n "${gslt}" ] && GSLT="+sv_setsteamaccount ${gslt}"
SVPW=""
[ -n "${sv_password}" ] && SVPW="+sv_password ${sv_password}"
RCON=""
[ -n "${rcon_password}" ] && RCON="+rcon_password ${rcon_password}"
exec ./game/bin/linuxsteamrt64/cs2 -dedicated -console -usercon -port ${port} -maxplayers_override ${maxplayers} $GSLT +game_type 0 +game_mode 1 +sv_visiblemaxplayers ${maxplayers} $SVPW $RCON +bot_quota 0 $MAPFLAG ${extra_args}
